summary: tailwindcss-contact-forms: obfuscated wallet-drainer harness masquerading as Tailwind CSS forms plugin
details: Package advertises itself as a Tailwind CSS forms plugin (repository field points at tailwindlabs/tailwindcss-forms; index.d.ts mirrors that project's plugin signature), but src/index.js is ~40KB of obfuscator.io-style code (rotating string array, hex-named identifiers) that runs at require time. On load it imports node:http, node:https, node:zlib, node:child_process (spawn), and node:url, stashes require, module, and global into short-named globals alongside a payload seed and string fragments consistent with assembling a JS blob for a spawned Node process. It also contacts multiple Ethereum JSON-RPC providers (eth-mainnet.public.blastapi.io, eth.drpc.org, ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com, publicnode) and an Etherscan-style txlist indexer against a hardcoded EOA (0xa322E5f39aDC2490EfD311D3080e6...), and reads the installer's ETH_RPC_URL env var to redirect that scanning through the caller's RPC. Behavior, obfuscation, and identity spoofing are inconsistent with any Tailwind CSS plugin functionality and match a wallet-drainer/frontrunner harness triggered by importing the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
